title: Anaesthetic Management of a Spontaneously Ruptured Vertebral Artery Pseudoaneurysm with Dynamic Airway Obstruction
abstract: Expanding neck hematoma with progressive airway obstruction is a life-threatening airway emergency. Patients are at risk of cranio-cerebral circulation compromise leading to perioperative cerebrovascular accidents. Furthermore, precipitous fall of blood pressure following neck hematoma exploration mandate the activation of protocols for massive transfusion. We describe the successful anaesthetic management of an extremely rare case of spontaneous rupture of a vertebral artery pseudoaneurysm.
